english.title: AATF operator fail to specify amount of non-obligated WEEE retained by designated collection facility operator

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being an operator of an AATF, in providing a report, namely **(..SPECIFY REPORT..) to **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), the appropriate authority, in accordance with regulation 66(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013, failed to specify the total amount in tonnes of non-obligated WEEE received by you that was retained by the operator of a designated collection facility under regulation 53 of those regulations by reference to the categories set out in regulation 66(3)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 66(3), 90(7)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
